patch_notes_facts: Scion retains the normal Ascendant path.
3.29 Reliquarian remains a Scion second-ascendancy research axis from the official Reliquarian reveal.
3.29 adds the Luminary Ascendancy Class for Scion.
Luminary can permanently hire Mercenaries.
Luminary can keep up to 3 permanently hired Mercenaries: 2 in reserve in towns/hideouts and 1 active combat ally.
Unlike regular Mercenaries, permanently hired Mercenary equipment can be changed by the player.
official_node_lens.build_implication: Scion 3.29 must first branch by selected ascendancy: Ascendant baseline, Reliquarian unique-node shells, or Luminary Mercenary slot planning.

official_node_lens.official_surface: Curse of the Allflame Challenge League
patch_notes_facts: Find Charts across Wraeclast, board The Sovereign, and dive to the ocean floor.
Lanterns imbued with the Allflame protect the player during ocean-floor exploration.
Completed charting can be connected into a Voyage that revisits chart rewards while amplifying them.
The ship heart can split an input item into multiple ghostly outcomes, one of which can be kept.
Ducats from the seafloor are used to twist items in new ways.
official_node_lens.build_implication: Early strategy needs mobility, survivability, and reward-loop measurement before committing to a farming tree.

patch_notes_facts: 3.29 introduces two Bloodline Classes, one exclusive to Curse of the Allflame.
Pact of Beidat empowers projectile, targeted-area, or chaining-beam spells while applying an Affliction.
Pact of Ghorr empowers damage-over-time spells while applying an Affliction and grants Hunger of Ghorr/Fleshrend behavior.
Pact of K'tash empowers damaging Vaal spells while applying an Affliction.
Pact of Lycia empowers self-cast channelling spells while applying an Affliction.
Coursing Currents and Crystalfall are new Exceptional Support Gems called out in the patch notes.
official_node_lens.build_implication: Blight of Contagion remains a live retest candidate because it overlaps DoT spell and channelling lenses; it can be evaluated under Luminary/Mercenary or a separate Reliquarian route.

patch_notes_facts: Mercenaries of Trarthus are core in 3.29.
Mercenary presence does not count as a player party member for monster life or item quantity/rarity scaling.
Mercenary encounters again provide Trarthan Gems and specific Mercenary uniques.
Trarthan Scarabs and Atlas passive support are added.
official_node_lens.build_implication: Farming and build planning must track Mercenary role: aura/utility, clear assist, boss assist, or defensive support.

patch_notes_facts: Gems can now be socketed in any equipment socket regardless of socket colour.
Sockets are white by default, with a chance to roll red, green, or blue based on item requirements and item level.
Chromatic Orbs now force one socket to be non-white while other sockets roll normally.
Currency that adds sockets generates added sockets as white.
Red/green/blue crafting bench socket-colour options are removed and replaced by non-white socket count options.
official_node_lens.build_implication: The coach should stop over-weighting colour friction for gem setup, but it must model non-white socket economy and special uniques such as Dialla's separately.

official_node_lens.official_surface: Abyss, Legion, Talisman, and Atlas changes
patch_notes_facts: Abyss, Legion, and Talisman have dedicated 3.29 revamp sections.
Legion splinter sources are restricted and concentrated into Legion encounters, Generals, Sergeants, Chests, and Kingsmarch Atlas Runners.
Atlas passive and scarab support changes require farming strategy refresh after launch.
official_node_lens.build_implication: Do not reuse 3.28 mechanic rankings unchanged; Legion, Abyss, and Allflame economy need launch-week calibration.

uncertainty_lens.rule: Patch notes and reveal are live, but the 3.29 league launch is July 24 PDT. Economy, drop rates, and actual Mercenary behavior still need launch data.
Scion 3.29 has three relevant ascendancy branches to keep separate: Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary. Do not mark Reliquarian as replaced by Luminary.
New Bloodline classes, Pact gems, Mercenary data, and Allflame item data require a fresh post-3.29 GGPK extraction before deterministic coach claims.
Do not flatten Mercenary gear/skills into player links. Model active Mercenary, reserve Mercenaries, gear, and role as separate state.
Official Gem Socket Changes concern equipment socket colour behavior and gem colour restrictions, not a recursive support-gem socket system.
Community build recommendations before launch should be marked as discussion/watchlist unless backed by a PoB and post-patch mechanics.
PoEWiki page bodies support Ascendant/Reliquarian/Luminary, but category API snapshots may lag or omit Luminary. Prefer page-body revisions over category membership for this specific crosscheck.

coach_rules: When this live 3.29 DB is injected, say patch notes are confirmed but launch economy and PoB support are still pending.
For Scion, first identify the selected ascendancy branch: Ascendant, Reliquarian, or Luminary.
Never present Reliquarian HoT, Ngamahu, Dawnbreaker, or Gloomfang branches as Luminary/Mercenary recommendations; keep them under the Reliquarian branch.
For Blight of Contagion, explain the 3.29 reason as Pact of Ghorr/Pact of Lycia overlap plus Mercenary support testing, not as a confirmed direct skill buff.
Separate player build state from Mercenary build state: player main skill links, active Mercenary role, reserve Mercenaries, and Mercenary equipment.
For socket advice, use the official 3.29 equipment socket colour changes and avoid claiming that skill gems gained recursive support sockets.
